description: Find CMS dataset IDs + titles by keyword. CMS publishes Medicare/Medicaid open data (provider data, spending, enrollment, drug pricing, quality measures, hospitals, nursing homes, ACOs, etc.). Searches the CMS DCAT catalog client-side over each dataset title/description/keywords. Returns the datasetId (UUID) you pass to get_dataset and dataset_info. Also covers the CMS Provider Data Catalog (the Care Compare datasets: hospitals, nursing homes, clinicians, dialysis, home health, facility affiliations; ids look like "27ea-46a8"): catalog "auto" (default) searches the open-data catalog and falls through to the Provider Data Catalog when it has no match; use "provider-data" to search only that one.

catalog.description: "auto" (default): open-data catalog, falling through to the Provider Data Catalog on no match. "open-data" or "provider-data" restricts to one.

name: cms_search_datasets
title: Cms Search Datasets
